claims.claim_en: Al‑Mu'minun (الْمُؤْمِنُونَ) functions as the ism (subject) of كان (i.e., the مبتدأ of كان).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk gives the analysis for the parallel construction (وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا ...). This claim extrapolates that analysis to this verse's (وَمَا كَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ...) — verify that al‑Tibyan explicitly treats المؤمنون as اسم كان in the commentary on this exact verse.

claims.claim_ar: قاعدة: في صيغة «وَمَا كَانَ ...» يكون ما بعدها اسماً لكان (اسم كان) وقد يكون عنصر مثل «لنا» هو الخبر.
claims.claim_en: Rule reference: In constructions like 'وَمَا كَانَ ...' the following noun serves as the ism of كان (اسم كان); elements such as 'لَنا' in the example can function as the predicate (خبر).

warnings: The available al‑Tibyan chunks do not quote this exact verse; the claims above are inferred from the provided parallel example (وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا أَنْ نَأْتِيَكُمْ). Confirm with the specific commentary on S9:A122 to ensure no different local analysis (e.g., alternative assignment of the خبر) is given.
